selected_evidence.requirement: Shared VIP configured on node1/node2 private network, answered by one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Generated keepalived.conf shows vrrp_instance VI_1 on br-lan for both nodes; node1 (priority 150, MASTER) holds 10.100.166.253/24 as secondary on br-lan, node2 (priority 100, BACKUP) does not.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 reaches the shared VIP in steady state (baseline)
selected_evidence.summary: 4/4 ping packets from node3 to 10.100.166.253 succeed, 0% loss, while node1 holds the VIP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Automatic takeover when the active node stops serving, with node3 continuity across the transition
selected_evidence.summary: node1's keepalived stopped and it dropped the VIP; node2 acquired 10.100.166.253 within ~3s; node3's continuous ping log shows all 62 sequence numbers (1-62) received with zero gaps, only a brief RTT bump during the VRRP handover, proving uninterrupted reachability through the failover.

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovery / failback after the disrupted node returns (redundancy restored)
selected_evidence.summary: node1's keepalived restarted, it preempted back to MASTER (VIP returned to node1), node2 reverted to BACKUP without the VIP, and node3 pings the VIP successfully afterward — confirming full pair redundancy restored.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 baseline boot identity + service health
selected_evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 3ca6f53e-81da-46b4-a718-fbdf857a242c, uptime, VIP present, keepalived running, prior to any restart of node1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged (connection closed by remote host) on node1's prior boot_id 3ca6f53e...; node stayed unreachable during the window; boot_id changed to 2b839074-7c83-4964-8397-7e7b5db0230a on recovery; keepalived running with VIP re-acquired; node3's second continuous ping log confirms 91/91 sequences received with zero gaps across node1's outage/recovery (node2 covering during the gap).

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ee4e2a22-7029-444d-a21e-5dec40f1bb24 captured; reboot issued and acknowledged; node timed out during restart; boot_id changed to 95f9e65b-d01f-42b6-b925-58478185a06d on return; keepalived auto-started and rejoined as BACKUP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 31949c21-52ad-47af-bdbe-893352fd509b captured; systemctl reboot issued (stream closed as expected); node timed out during restart; boot_id changed to d0d7b7b6-04a1-4c8f-a407-280a987b87a2 on return; node3 network restored and successfully pinged the shared VIP (0% loss) post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster health after all three restarts
selected_evidence.summary: node1 is MASTER holding the VIP with keepalived running and enabled, node2 is BACKUP with keepalived running and enabled, and node3 successfully pings the VIP — confirming the pair and the client are all healthy after the full restart cycle.
